agency.name: Tennessee Department of Mental Health and Substance Abuse Services (TDMHSAS)

narrNote: TN-ARR is on NARR's official affiliate list (fetched in-run 2026-10-22); its own site was fetched and verified and self-describes TN-ARR as Tennessee's official recovery housing certification organization and state affiliate of NARR.
notes: Agency is Tennessee's SAMHSA Single State Agency (TDMHSAS); department page fetched and verified; agency phone is the TDMHSAS Helpline number published on tn.gov. Crisis: the Tennessee REDLINE (call/text 800-889-9789, 24/7/365) is the state's SUD-specific referral line, operated by TAADAS under contract with TDMHSAS — REDLINE's own tn.gov page could not be fetched due to research-tool rate limiting, so the verified TDMHSAS Helpline page, which documents the REDLINE, is linked; Tennessee's separate Statewide Crisis Line for mental-health emergencies is 855-274-7471. Tennessee 211 is a collaborative of regional United Way 211 centers whose shared statewide portal is tn211.org (named on the verified hub page); tn211.org itself could not be fetched in-run due to tool rate limiting, so the verified United Way of Greater Nashville 211 page — the Middle Tennessee hub covering 42 counties — is the linked URL. countyDirectory is null: TDMHSAS publishes no county or regional directory (services are delivered by contracted community providers statewide); FindHelpNowTN.org exists but is a per-facility locator, excluded under the directory's no-per-facility-listings rule. TennCare (TN Medicaid) covers SUD treatment including MAT, detox and residential services through its managed care organizations, via the verified TennCare hub.
